content_of_post_to_answer: What exactly is brain hygiene, and how can it improve my daily life and mental well-being?
answer: Brain hygiene is less about forcing positive thoughts and more about managing what repeatedly enters and stays in your mind. Just as physical hygiene prevents problems before they appear, mental hygiene reduces the buildup of noise, stress, resentment, and distraction. A useful distinction is that your brain is not only shaped by what you deliberately learn, but also by what you repeatedly consume. The quality of your attention becomes the quality of your inner life.
